title: Story premise ENT080: The Kite String That Stayed
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: There is still a place for your hand. Takeaway/theme: A small marker can preserve a shared moment.
description: Two friends want to keep flying a kite together, but one must leave before the breeze ends. They tie a tiny ribbon at the last shared grip point; the remaining friend flies the kite from below the ribbon and later wraps the spool with both names before putting it away.
